scope: Development-only model diagnosis. No GUI/capture/executor/input, no production changes, no live success claim.

execution.exit0_meaning: Diagnostic harness completed; it does not mean semantic plans or GUI tasks succeeded.

No evidence of deleted caller text or wrong role ordering; stop and small usage do not support output-token exhaustion. Exact reason length 300 alone does not establish decoder internals.

findings.finding: A made status ready after adding the exact schema text, but duplicate postconditions and title-as-action instructions made the plan invalid. Schema visibility is not a semantic correctness fix.

B produced a cleaner three-objective intent sequence without the current snapshot. Existing local validation passed; no goal was executed. Review and Commit are speculative UI literals and can be visible before the operation or absent afterward.
C failed the explicit missing-project negative control. It returned ready and copied [not specified] into an executable objective, with invented completion labels.
Current-screen affordance labels and future intended states are being conflated; separating intent and UI grounding is promising but is not proven sufficient by these three probes.
Schema text, property order/status priming, and limited model capability may affect output. This serial three-case development experiment does not establish a unique cause or a success rate.

registered_limitations: B/C intentionally retain the A/v4 system sentence describing OCR/window input although no current snapshot is supplied; their failure alone cannot disprove intent-only architecture.
No new GUI observation or executor is constructed or called; local postparse checks use only the archived normal006 snapshot.
All outputs including nonready, invalid or errored replies are retained without correction; no format retry.
Readiness is development evidence only, not real task execution, independent final success or general application quality.

primary_source.supported_claim: Ollama documents OpenAI-compatible response_format support and recommends supplying the schema as text in the prompt too.

proposed_v5_assessment.recommendation: A constrained caller-predicate protocol is a principled restriction, not a proof of general semantic planning. Do not ship B unchanged or force ready.
minimal_surface: dedicated CPU contract/negative tests; no action layer, observation, executor or monitor changes required
required_rules: Archive the complete initial snapshot/pixels, but declare high-level caller-intent-only input honestly. Keep current pixels in the action layer.
Send the same dynamic schema both as response_format and as prompt text. Preserve legitimate refusal/clarification and do not impose minItems=2 on the non-ready branch.

Only original caller.expect values may appear as positive goal predicates; only original caller.forbid values may appear as negative predicates. Validate exact native membership before normalization; never fabricate, invert, truncate or silently repair strings.
Detect a bounded declared set of explicit unresolved placeholders before model dispatch and stop with named evidence. This is not general natural-language ambiguity detection.

Keep at least two native meaningful objectives initially; permit model-chosen grouping of adjacent requested operations when their completion can be tied to caller predicates. Do not provide a fixture-specific goal skeleton.
Keep duplicate/replay checks and fresh before-input whole-predicate false requirement for every goal. More than one supplied final string does not imply distinct achievable stages.

Preserve successful real OS-input receipts, fresh scoped error-free post observations, unchanged caller final verification, shared request/action/planning/deadline limits, and unknown/cancel/failure stop semantics.
Retain raw failed contracts and raw proposals; future revisions occur before subsequent input and cannot relabel earlier failed checks as passed.
risks: Three caller strings may be equivalent by case/substring or become true together. Count alone is not proof of two independently distinguishable stages; use exact syntactic checks plus runtime before guards and report unsupported cases candidly.

A text conjunction may establish an observable result without proving every requested hidden semantic operation. Independent fixture events/actual receipts are still needed for acceptance coverage; do not claim arbitrary application semantic correctness.
Current per-goal check limits are 200 characters/8 items; caller values outside representable bounds require explicit unsupported/clarification, not truncation.
An unresolved-slot detector only covers declared placeholder forms. It does not guarantee recognition of all missing required values in ordinary prose.
A model may still output semantically unrelated instructions despite exact predicate membership. Negative controls and real complete native sequence execution remain mandatory.
acceptance_needed: Native initial sequence with at least two distinct objectives and caller-grounded frozen predicates
Explicit missing-slot negative stops before any HTTP/input
Unapproved literals/case or whitespace substitutions rejected locally
Real normal and transient full runs with each stage before/receipt/post evidence and independent unchanged fresh final
Independent event audit verifies requested operations actually occurred without replay or unknown dispatch
